sentences.pinyin: wǒ ài wǒ de mā ma。
tā ài hē chá。
wǒ yǒu bā gè péng you。
xiàn zài bā diǎn le。
wǒ bà ba zài jiā。
bà ba xǐ huan hē chá。
wǒ men qù ba。
nǐ zuò ba。
bái tiān wǒ zài xué xiào。
sentences.english: During the day I am at school.

sentences.pinyin: jīn tiān bái tiān hěn rè。
sentences.english: It is very hot during the day today.

sentences.pinyin: zhè běn shū yī bǎi kuài。
sentences.english: This book is one hundred yuan.

sentences.pinyin: wǒ yǒu yī bǎi gè zì。
xiàn zài jiǔ diǎn bàn。
sentences.english: It is half past nine now.

sentences.pinyin: wǒ xué xí le bàn gè xiǎo shí。
sentences.english: I studied for half an hour.

sentences.pinyin: wǒ xǐ huan chī bāo zi。
zhè gè bāo zi hěn hǎo chī。
zhè gè bēi zi hěn piào liang。
wǒ de bēi zi zài zhuō zi shàng。
sentences.english: My cup is on the table.

sentences.pinyin: wǒ yǒu sān běn shū。
zhè běn shū hěn hǎo kàn。

sentences.hanzi: 他一边吃饭，一边看电视。
sentences.pinyin: tā yī biān chī fàn，yī biān kàn diàn shì。
tā yī biān shuō huà，yī biān xiě zì。
zhè gè hěn pián yi。
wǒ de bìng hǎo le。
tā yǒu bìng，qù yī yuàn kàn yī shēng。
sentences.english: He is ill and goes to the hospital to see a doctor.

sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng chī fàn。
xiè xie！bù kè qi。
nǐ shuō xiè xie，wǒ shuō bù kè qi。
sentences.english: You say thanks, and I say you're welcome.

sentences.pinyin: nǐ bù yào shuō huà。
wǒ bù yào chá，wǒ yào shuǐ。
sentences.english: I don't want tea, I want water.

sentences.pinyin: zhè gè cài hěn hǎo chī。
wǒ xiǎng qù mǎi cài。
sentences.english: I want to go buy vegetables.

sentences.pinyin: wǒ xǐ huan hē chá。
nǐ hē chá ma？
tā huì chàng hěn duō gē。
chāo shì lǐ yǒu hěn duō shuǐ guǒ。
sentences.english: There is a lot of fruit in the supermarket.

sentences.pinyin: wǒ qù chāo shì mǎi niú nǎi。
sentences.english: I go to the supermarket to buy milk.
